proposals.current: GTA Online's Megalodon Shark Card has been $99.99 since 2013. CPI adjustment to 2026 (~35% inflation) implies a real-terms equivalent of ~$135, suggesting a nominal increase is economically justified. Take-Two has historically kept nominal prices flat while engineering real-terms inflation via payout nerfs. A price increase at the launch of a new title would be the cleanest reset point.
